analysis.reasonEn: RSI has entered oversold territory for 3 consecutive sessions, and ADX at 19.4 indicates no established trend. Following sharp declines of -10.86%, -1.96%, -8.24%, and -5.59% over the past five days, attempts at a rebound have been made, but the price remains below SMA5 ($32,042) and SMA20 ($36,542), continuing the weak trend. The price is in a sideways range at 44.0% of its 52-week low ($8,495). Entry for buying will be decided after confirmation of recovery above SMA20.
